__comment: Module→folder aliases + justified deferrals for ledger.mjs sync. product-categories rows are covered by specs in the categories/ folder.

defer.reason: The send happy-path (dispatch → stamp sent_at → registered transition) needs a pending-GHL-contact fixture (only an inbound webhook creates one) AND dispatches a real magic-link email to the contact's address, so it isn't run in CI. Wiring, RBAC, the clean-404 error path, and the listApprovedContacts lifecycle shape ARE covered by ghl-onboarding-handoff.rule.spec.ts; the dispatch itself mirrors the tested resendMagicLink path. Cover fully when a webhook-simulation + email-capture fixture exists.

The households router has no delete procedure and the tenant DB connectionString is encrypted (no direct SQL) — a spec would strand an E2E household + customer-profile row in the shared dev tenant, violating the no-orphans discipline. Needs a households/delete procedure or a disposable tenant fixture. (Corroborated by the SKIP note in customers/customer-profiles.lifecycle.spec.ts.)

Requires flipping the live dev org's paymentStatus to suspended/cancelled — a mid-run crash would lock the shared tenant for every concurrent session. Needs a throwaway org fixture (Neon branch) before this is safe to automate.
Same as suspended/cancelled: mutating the shared dev org's paymentStatus mid-run risks read-only-locking the tenant other sessions are using. Needs a throwaway org fixture.
